test_cases.name: youtube_shorts_low_views
test_cases.input: My latest YouTube Short only has 1 view and 1 engaged view at 100%. Why isn't YouTube testing it?
assertions: Explains Shown in feed vs engaged views
Notes that 1 engaged view means distribution barely started
Mentions checking Shown in feed in Studio

test_cases.name: x_follower_origin
test_cases.input: I got two new followers on Twitter. Can you check where they came from? My username is jasejokerr
assertions: States private follower lists are not accessible
Directs user to sort Followers by Latest
Mentions X Analytics or third-party tools for aggregate location

test_cases.name: shorts_uneven_performance
test_cases.input: Some of my YouTube Shorts get thousands of views and others get almost nothing. I upload everything the same way from CapCut.
assertions: Explains seed audience testing and retention variance
References Oct 2026 originality update for clip-style content
Notes CapCut upload method is not the cause
